name: The Appalache Estate
summary: A browser-playable comedic mystery set on a private Appalachian mineral-water estate. As a newly admitted guest, the player arrives the morning three Commonwealth inspectors show up unannounced for the annual bottling inspection. Three small errands unravel into a real anomaly involving a tank, a flow meter, and blueprints that have shown a door since 1961 that isn't physically there. Case 01, "The Annual Pour," runs 18-24 minutes for a first play and ends with a player choice - Conceal, Disclose, or Investigate - that resolves into a named case disposition. It features a live-conversation NPC and an automatic cinematic camera system.
